crossRefs.note: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them…
Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

translations.web: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
translations.bsb: My companions saw the light, but they could not understand the voice of the One speaking to me.
translations.kjv: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
translations.asv: And they that were with me beheld indeed the light, but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
